Titano(Apple Pie) by King Kong Vape Juice
:

gurus. This
Apple Pie e-juice
takes on a popular classic and does it justice with an exquisite formulation that uses only the best ingredients available. Crisp and luscious apples are dusted with fragrant cinnamon and cooked to perfection before being covered with a thin layer of buttery pastry crust.
The fresh sweetness of the baked fruits, coupled with a slight sense of cinnamon spice, will be tasted on the inhale, followed by an exhale of the delicate but rich, flaky pie crust.
The flavours complement each other beautifully, allowing you to totally immerse yourself in a lovely Apple Pie experience.
